name: Marea de Recuerdos
source:
"Marea de Recuerdos" is a visual novel in which you take on the role of a young college graduate who returns to his hometown before entering his adult life completely. During his arrival he begins to have anxiety attacks when he encounters old friends and new people. 

Manage to overcome his insecurities and help him reunite with his friends while discovering the reason for his social anxiety.

[Translated from [url=https://ralph-derg.itch.io/marea-de-recuerdos]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Marea de Recuerdos》是一部视觉小说，你将扮演一名年轻的大学毕业生，在完全进入成年生活之前回到家乡。在抵达期间，当他遇到老朋友和新朋友时，他开始感到焦虑。

设法克服他的不安全感，帮助他与朋友团聚，同时找出他社交焦虑的原因。

[译自[url=https://ralph-derg.itch.io/marea-de-recuerdos]Itch.io[/url]]
